title: Grateful Dead Live at Taft Auditorium on 1971-10-30
source: Updated Recording Info: Pre FM SBD > MR > RR @ 7 1/2 IPS; Transfer Info: RR > 1978 Teac 3440 > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Transfered, tracked and mastered by Bill Guarneri, August 1, 2014

ai_review.summary: Excellent performance with a standout 'Comes A Time' and lively 'Truckin''; recording quality not described but presumed solid.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the show, calling it one of the best ever heard and highlighting Jerry Garcia’s witty banter, his string‑scratching intro to "Truckin'", and a superb pedal‑steel cameo during the NRPS set. The music is described as an excellent evening of high energy, with no complaints about audio fidelity, suggesting a listenable source despite unknown recording specifics.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic reviews (5 and 4 stars) focus on strong musical performance with no noted audio problems; limited data yields a moderate confidence level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention any sound issues, implying the recording is acceptable though its exact source (soundboard/audience) is unclear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers praised the overall flow, especially the transition into "Truckin'" and a memorable NRPS segment with Jerry on pedal steel.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for witty comments, sarcastic string‑scratching before "Truckin'", and excellent pedal‑steel work during the NRPS set.
